summary: Huachen AI Parking Management Technology Holding Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held October 13, 2026 (Beijing time). Holders representing roughly 90.84% of voting power approved four proposals: reducing Class B voting rights from 200 to 30 votes per share by special resolution; a 20-for-1 share consolidation effective October 23, 2026, recasting par value to US$0.00075; adopting amended articles reflecting both changes; and a meeting-adjournment authorization. Each proposal passed by overwhelming margins with negligible opposition. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer meeting notice and outcome, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation beyond standard approval were disclosed.
